name: Code Repository Manager
description: Registers configured Git repositories as Agent context and prepares Git authentication before runtime sessions start.

requires_env.name: EXPERTMESH_PLUGIN_CODE_REPOSITORY_MANAGER_GIT_TOKEN
requires_env.description: Optional HTTPS Git token used by the code repository manager when cloning private repositories.

requires_env.name: EXPERTMESH_PLUGIN_CODE_REPOSITORY_MANAGER_GIT_USERNAME
requires_env.description: Optional HTTPS Git username paired with the token. Defaults to x-access-token.

requires_env.name: EXPERTMESH_PLUGIN_CODE_REPOSITORY_MANAGER_GIT_CREDENTIAL_HELPER
requires_env.description: Optional git credential.helper value used for session Git authentication.

requires_env.name: EXPERTMESH_PLUGIN_CODE_REPOSITORY_MANAGER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
requires_env.description: Optional SSH private key used by the code repository manager for SSH Git remotes.

requires_env.name: EXPERTMESH_PLUGIN_CODE_REPOSITORY_MANAGER_SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS
requires_env.description: Optional known_hosts content used with the SSH private key.

capabilities.name: code-repositories.md
capabilities.description: Exposes configured repository metadata to the Agent context system.

capabilities.name: beforeSessionCreate
capabilities.description: Checks Git CLI availability and prepares session-level Git authentication environment.
